message: Outside T4.1: words.w5.components[0] (viśva) is a neuter noun meaning 'universe', but its sense.gloss quotes the adjective sense from mw-vishva.md ('all, every; whole, entire, universal'). The meaning is still supported, because mw-vishva.md p. 992,3 gives 'vi/śva : n. the whole world, universe'. The gloss should probably quote that noun sense instead.
